programme.title: Go, Dog. Go!

programme.desc: Now that they’re officially on the run, the team heads down to Mexico City to hide out in one of Ms. Nowhere’s many safe houses. With super-agent Palindrome and the police hot on their tales, they decide the only way they’re going to survive is by getting their hands on some money by winning an underground derby race.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers
programme.desc: Unable to decide how to prove their innocence, the team has a huge fight! Ms. Nowhere and Echo Pearl reach out to Palindrome with the evidence they've collected while Tony and Cisco find Uncle Tuco at a lucha libra match, where Cisco must face the ultimate question: can you always trust family?

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers
programme.desc: When the team learns of several robberies in Mexico City that resemble the attack on the agency. Ms. Nowhere puts the pieces together and realizes who set them up: an ex-operative she used to work with named Moray. Now, she and the crew must infiltrate a masquerade ball to come face to face with Moray and figure out what he's up to.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: Struggling to find their purpose on the Betterman farm, the Croods see an opportunity to prove their worth by harvesting Phil’s perilous (and sticky) bounceberries.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: When Eep wants alone time with her new friend Dawn, Guy seeks a new friend of his own and finds an unlikely companion in Thunk.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: When the Bettermans invite the Croods to join their family game night, two things become clear: Phil needs to win and Grug hates to lose.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2
programme.desc: While punished, Tom must sneak out to rescue the Riders from Buzzsaw.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2
programme.desc: Tom orchestrates a “safe” tour of the realms to convince Olivia that the Hidden World is safe for them to explore.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: Following the events of the feature, Yi struggles to recreate her violin magic without Everest. While her mom and NaiNai prepare for the grand opening of their family dumpling shop, Yi, Jin, and Peng discover that Yi’s violin has attracted a magical bird-like creature, Fenghuang, who needs their help. Yi’s music also calls on Everest, who returns to join the crew and find Fenghuang a suitable home.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: While Yi and the crew try to pinpoint how Yi’s magic works, they notice that Everest isn’t looking too hot. In fact, he’s too hot. The crew tries everything to cool him down, even begging their old foe, Burnish, for help. Out of options, Yi tries to use her magic to send Everest home – until Burnish and his jerboa sidekick, Duchess, reveal that they’ve made over the kids’ rooftop fort into a high-tech HQ, complete with various tech gadgets for the crew and a temperature-controlled chamber for Everest.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Birch manages to convince Liam that Sandra's grade-threatening bad mood stems from boy trouble. In an effort to get her out of her funk and into studying again, the cousins invent a secret admirer for Sandra. They soon find Sandra's constant need for affirmation exhausting — a further complication in their attempt to keep up their group grade point average.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: When Sandra signs Pod 4 up for an academic quiz show, the kids are soon figuring out how to best leverage their TV exposure. It soon becomes obvious that four separate agenda do not add up to a cohesive team as they suffer near humiliation at the hands of the preppie team from Rydell High.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Raffi's win at the district art show hurtles Birch into the five stages of grief, her reactions throwing her podmates for a loop. Luckily, Liam's hip to what's going on thanks to a book Mr. Towes has assigned him. While Sandra trails Liam in hopes of seeing some emotional fireworks on Birch's part, Raffi can't quite get over the idea that Birch wouldn't be happy for his success.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Birch is initially aghast when Jason publishes her Manga “sample” in the school paper, but soon succumbs to the allure of popularity. As Birch's social status soars, her podmates become laughingstocks. Sandra's retaliation eventually brings the two girls together in their fight against the unethical editor of The Cosmos Chronicle.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: It's a snow day and school's closed. Olivia takes to the snow-covered streets with Julian as her cameraman, to report on all the snow day happenings. The biggest story of the day turns out to be an alleged sighting of the legendary abominable snowman. Can it be true? Olivia tracks down the real story.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia can't wait to see skating star Sonja Spencer perform in “Cinderella on Ice.” She's sure she'll be the lucky audience member chosen to skate with Sonja, and begins practicing on the skating rink she makes in her own backyard. When the show is canceled, Olivia decides the show must go on and she and her friends stage their own ice spectacular.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia sees herself as a great concert pianist, though her piano teacher thinks she needs a little more practice. But when her little brother Ian begins taking his own piano lessons – and turns out to be pretty good – Olivia isn't sure if there's room for two prodigies in the family.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Francine is chosen to play goalie, and Olivia is disappointed that she doesn't get to wear the red goalie jersey. Even worse, the uniform she designs for herself only causes chaos and confusion among her teammates. But when Francine is better at dodging the ball than stopping it, it's up to Olivia to put on the red goalie jersey and save the day

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: When Phoebe accidentally knocks Harper's soccer cleat off the balcony before the big game, the Dew Drops must venture into the city to retrieve the cleat. / When Dylan starts practicing magic tricks, Athena thinks his magic is real! But when the Dew Drops investigate his “magic hat,” they accidentally break it and must fix it before Dylan’s magic show for the neighborhood kids.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go
programme.desc: When the crew takes on a mission to help Ian get some rest for a Badminton Tournament, Jax realises that the biggest approach isn't always the best approach. / When Lula loses her comic book, Ari learns that the best heroes rely on teamwork and not gadgets.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go
programme.desc: When a pesky gopher gets in the way of Fawna making her famous veggie stew, Niah learns to not let a bad experience, get in the way of doing good. / When the inexperienced Rona has to step in for Donna, the team makes sure everyone has the best camping trip ever.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Bully For You When Casper decides he can't take any more of Thatch's nastiness, he forms a secret squad dedicated to putting an end to bullying. The Ra-minator Using the power of invisibility, Casper offers to help transform Ra from a sports zero to an athletic hero.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Weekend at Bunny's Alder and Dash sound the alarm after a terrifying creature threatens Scare School. Grimly Day It's Grimly Day?the grimmest day of the year!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
programme.desc: Gabby and Pandy accidentally get turned teeny-tiny when one of Mercat's potions spills. To get back to their normal size, they need to find the right ingredients to make a grow potion, which means going on an itty-bitty search through the dollhouse! For our Cat of the Day segment, Mercat shows us how to make sparkly, mermaid slime.

programme.desc: Matutong pahalagahan at unawain ang pamilya at mga kasapi nito kabilang ang mga bahaging ginagampanan ng bawat isa.

programme.title: Grade 2 Filipino
programme.desc: Alamin ang mga elemento at bahagi ng kuwento, kabilang na ang pagpaghihinuha at pagbibigay ng susunod na pangyayari sa kuwento.

programme.title: Grade 2 Math
programme.desc: Learn how to subtract and multiply whole numbers up to 1000 including money.

programme.title: Grade 2 English
programme.desc: Identify different parts of a book and their uses, as well as learn about action words and words with short vowels.

programme.title: Grade 2 Araling Palipunan
programme.desc: Matutong unawain ang kuwento ng pinagmulan ng sariling komunidad batay sa konsepto ng pagbabago at pagpapatuloy upang mapahalagahan ang kulturang nabuo ng komunidad.

programme.title: Grade 3 Filipino
programme.desc: Alamin kung paano gumamit ng magagalang na pananalita, salitang naglalarawan, at angkop na tanong. Alamin rin ang mga salitang magkatugma, pagkukumpara ng kuwento at pagbibigay ng wakas dito.

programme.title: Grade 3 Math
programme.desc: Learn multiplication and division of whole numbers including money.

programme.title: Grade 3 English
programme.desc: Know more about verbs, pronouns, consonant blends, and digraphs, as well as different sources of information and how to identify facts and opinions.

programme.title: Grade 3 Araling Panlipunan
programme.desc: Matutong unawain at pahalagahan ang iba’t ibang kwento at mga sagisag na naglalarawan ng sariling lalawigan at mga karatig lalawigan sa kinabibilangang rehiyon.

programme.title: Grade 3 Science
programme.desc: Discover the parts and functions of the sense organs of the human body; parts and functions of animals and plants and their importance to humans; the characteristics of living and nonliving things and the basic needs of plants, animals and humans.

programme.title: Grade 7 Filipino
programme.desc: Alamin ang mga antas ng wika at mga salitang may kinalaman sa paghahambing, pati na rin ang pagsusulat at pagsusuri ng awitin at editoryal na sulatin.

programme.title: Grade 7 Math
programme.desc: Learn about key concepts of measurement, algebraic expressions, the properties of real numbers as applied in linear equations, and inequalities in one variable.

programme.title: Grade 7 English
programme.desc: Know more about listening strategies, navigating websites, and using search engines, as well as summarizing key information, doing research, using analogy, and transcoding information.

programme.title: Grade 7 Araling Panlipunan
programme.desc: Aralin ang kaisipang Asyano, pilosopiya, at relihiyon na nagbigay daan sa paghubog ng sinaunang kabihasnan sa Asya at sa pagbuo ng pagkakakilanlang Asyano.

programme.title: Grade 7 Science
programme.desc: Differentiate the parts and functions of the compound microscope and the different levels of biological organization, alongside the comparison between animal and plant cells, reproduction, and interaction between organisms.

programme.title: Alternative Learning System
programme.desc: Learn about the process of planning, setting up, running a small business, and entrepreneurial skills.

programme.title: Grade 5 Filipino
programme.desc: Aralin ang wastong pagbabaybay, paggamit ng mga bantas. Alamin rin kung ano ang pandiwa at pang-uri, at kung paano sumuri ng dokyumentaryo, talaarawan at talambuhay.

programme.title: Grade 5 Math
programme.desc: Learn about decimals and the four fundamental operations involving decimals, ratio, and proportion.

programme.title: Grade 5 English
programme.desc: Identify aspects of verbs, modal, conjunctions and point of views.

programme.title: Grade 5 Araling Panlipunan
programme.desc: Unawain ang konteksto sa bahaging ginampanan ng simbahan sa layunin at mga paraan ng pananakopng Espanyol sa Pilipinas at ang epekto ng mga ito sa lipunan.

programme.title: Grade 5 Science
programme.desc: Learn how the parts of the human reproductive system work and how animals and plants reproduce, as well as the interactions for survival among living and nonliving things that take place in estuaries and intertidal zones.

programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.
